title: Each cross-tree switch reads the per-thread CPU clock with a system call, five `clock_gettime` per JSON request.
text: The read charges `[limits] cpu_time` to the right request, so it cannot be dropped or coarsened. Closing it is a cheaper clock that still charges every switch to the request it ran for, shown by the json-api profile's `clock_gettime` count falling and every CPU-time limit test staying green.
